name: Razorpay
description: Access your Razorpay merchant data directly from Claude. Query payments, orders, refunds, and settlements instantly through natural conversation. Track QR code transactions, monitor payment links, review payout history, and generate settlement reconciliation reports—all without leaving your AI workflow. Transform Claude into your intelligent merchant dashboard that retrieves real-time business insights, helping you understand payment trends and reconcile transactions faster, with less friction.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Razorpay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Razorpay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.razorpay.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Razorpay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Razorpay lists 25 MCP tools, including fetch_payment, fetch_all_payments, fetch_payment_card_details, fetch_order, fetch_all_orders, fetch_order_payments, fetch_payment_link, fetch_all_payment_links, fetch_qr_code, fetch_all_qr_codes, fetch_qr_codes_by_customer_id, and fetch_qr_codes_by_payment_id.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Razorpay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Razorpay in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Razorpay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Razorpay is developed by Razorpay Software Private Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
